skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The clothes Hoshiguma put on once more in Mitsukue.
Suited for fieldwork, suited for intimidating yakuza, and as recently discovered, very suited for street racing in the rain.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Once more does she wear these clothes as she steps onto a dangerous road, but her heart is unlike that of yesteryear.
She is her family's shield, protecting everyone who is a part of it. No longer will she stand alone.
